title.narrative: Building capacities of CTP partners to promote sustainable VSLA for resilience - Phase II project.

description.narrative: This project is designed to build the capacity of 15 CTP partner staffs from Caritas Diocese of Malakal (CDoM), Caritas Diocese of Rumbek) (CDoR) and The organization of Children Harmony (TOCH). The project will provide knowledge and skills development in the areas of promoting and sustaining VSLAs, formation of women federations, monitoring of VSLA groups, sustainability of the VSLA groups and & federations, promotion of micro businesses and group enterprises. The project will equip 15 key staff from the above-mentioned partners so that they are able to transfer the skills to the VSLA groups. The Village Savings and Loans Associations (VSLA) concept has proven to be a very effective tool to support community mobilization to build resilience. In the last six years to 2024, CTP supported the Daughters of Mary Immaculate and collaborators (SDMIC) to introduce VSLA in Yirol East County.
